_what: Assignment pack for the process specification campaign. Everything you need about YOUR category. The full model.json is 148 KB and you do not need it; if you want a process id outside this category, ask.
_binding: _Collab/00_prompts/SPEC_CAMPAIGN_PROMPT.md is the binding instruction. _Collab/SOURCE_AUTHORITY_PACK.md is the only permitted source list. Read both in full before writing anything.

bands.Work Lifecycle: 1.0-5.0. Runs in sequence for a single piece of work.
bands.Specialised Operations: 6.0-11.0. Each runs the full lifecycle inside its own operational discipline.
bands.Foundations and Enabling: 12.0-16.0. Supplies assets, materials, workforce, information and external delivery capacity to every lifecycle stage rather than sitting inside the sequence.
bands.Asset Lifecycle: 17.0-19.0. The asset's own life - planned, created, operated and retired - as distinct from the work performed on it. Appended 2026-08-29 without renumbering anything: categories 1.0 to 16.0 keep their ids, uids and legacy_ids.

lifecycle_axis._why: The model is organised on a WORK axis - identify, plan, schedule, execute, close. APQC and GFMAM are organised on an ASSET axis - plan and acquire, design and construct, operate, maintain, dispose. The work axis is what happens inside 'maintain'. Both are valid; carrying both lets the model answer ISO 55001:2024 cl. 8.1 without abandoning the granularity that makes it a process model rather than a benchmarking taxonomy.
lifecycle_axis._all: 'all' marks an enabling category that serves every stage rather than sitting at one of them.

your_category.name: Manage Workforce and Time

processes.name: Provision and de-provision system and mobile access
Identify covered tasks and qualify individuals
Apply span-of-control and abnormal-operating-condition rules on assignment
Record time against work in the field

groups.name: Cost labour and interface to payroll

processes.name: Apply pay rules, premiums and agreements
Post labour cost to work and project

your_category.summary: Maintain who is available, what they are qualified for, and what their time costs.

gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.name: Competence Management
gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.note: Skills and certification, which the model correctly treats as gating work assignment rather than as an HR record.
